title: Localizing Concepts in Visual Autoregressive Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.40061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding the internal routing of visual concepts is crucial for the safe and controllable adaptation of generative models. While concept localization has been widely studied in diffusion models, the emerging paradigm of next-scale visual autoregressive models remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we introduce LoCo, the first model-agnostic framework to localize where and when specific concepts emerge within autoregressive models. Driven by the native coarse-to-fine nature of next-scale generation, our method precisely maps conceptual knowledge across three distinct dimensions: Layer, Scale, and Position. To systematically localize and evaluate concept routing without context bias, we propose LoCoBench, a comprehensive dataset spanning 10 diverse categories. translated_title: 在视觉自回归模型中定位概念
translated_abstract: 理解视觉概念的内部路由对于生成模型的安全和可控适配至关重要。虽然概念定位在扩散模型中已被广泛研究，但新兴的下一尺度视觉自回归模型范式在很大程度上仍未被探索。在本文中，我们提出了LoCo，这是第一个模型无关的框架，用于定位特定概念在自回归模型中于何处以及何时涌现。受下一尺度生成固有的从粗到细特性驱动，我们的方法在三个不同维度上精确映射概念知识：层、尺度和位置。为了在没有上下文偏差的情况下系统地定位和评估概念路由，我们提出了LoCoBench，一个涵盖10个多样化类别的综合数据集。对图像和视频自回归模型（如Infinity、HunyuanImage-3.0和InfinityStar）的广泛探测表明，定位出的位置既具可解释性……
tldr: 提出首个模型无关的框架LoCo，通过在层、尺度、位置三个维度上精确定位概念的涌现，并结合LoCoBench数据集，实现了对视觉自回归模型内部概念路由的系统性分析与评估。
en_tdlr: LoCo, the first model-agnostic framework, localizes where and when concepts emerge in visual autoregressive models across Layer, Scale, and Position dimensions, complemented by LoCoBench for bias-free systematic evaluation.
